name: mercadopago-commerce
description: Wires Mercado Pago Checkout Pro into an Anthropic commerce-agents deployment. Implements the blueprint's checkout_handoff so a shopping agent hands its cart to a real Mercado Pago hosted checkout, with prices rebuilt server-side from the catalog and the payment confirmed by lookup rather than by redirect. Requires the mercadopago plugin for its bundled Checkout Pro reference and MCP server.
